confusing.why: The 1.3k token count is never explained, so a newcomer may read it as a price or a typo. The trace does add up (520 + 780), but the text doesn't say so.
The first step has no hint about where the 'new workflow' button or the node '+' is, so a beginner can't tell what to click.
Three definitions of 'agent' in one panel, each with a zoom metaphor. A newcomer loses track of which one the lesson actually uses for the rest of the lesson.
A named person is quoted with no link or date. A newcomer can't check it, and the lesson doesn't say how it was verified.
The five cards are dense, and the two 'watch it run' examples come after all five. The reader has to remember the cards before seeing them move.
The key is loaded into openai_api_key and checked, but never passed to OpenAI(). The client finds it on its own, and the lesson never says so, so the reader is left wondering why the key is loaded at
The checklist says load_dotenv should print True, but nothing says what False means. The quiz asks about False afterwards, and the answer appears only after you guess.
pip and 'terminal' are used without explanation, and this is the first time a newcomer has to open either one.
